posts.title: The Real Replacement
posts.description: The Industrial Revolution took our physical labour. We consoled ourselves with our minds. Now AI is here for those too. The question we keep avoiding: what exactly do we have left to offer?

posts.title: The craft isn’t dying. The bar is just rising.
posts.description: AI has changed what it costs to build. It has not changed what it takes to know what is worth building.

posts.title: Introducing Anchorpoint: an experiment in fighting misinformation
posts.description: What if instead of telling people what to think, we just made it easier to see the full picture? That's the question Anchorpoint is trying to answer. It's an experiment — and I'd love your help shaping it.
